q: What is Sunway College Kathmandu?
a: Sunway College Kathmandu is a private college in Kathmandu established in 2007. Sunway College Kathmandu is a leading private college in Nepal offering internationally-partnered undergraduate programs in Computer Science, Business Information Technology and Business Administration.

q: Where is Sunway College located?
alt: how do I reach the campus
a: Sunway College Kathmandu is at Behind Maitidevi Temple, Maitidevi, Kathmandu, Nepal — Behind Maitidevi Temple.

q: What are your office hours?
a: Our office is open Sunday–Friday: 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM.

q: How can I contact Sunway College?
a: You can call 01-4531725 / 01-4523736 / 9823047066, email info@sunway.edu.np, or write to admissions at admission@sunway.edu.np.

q: Which university are your degrees from?
a: Sunway College Kathmandu works in academic partnership with Birmingham City University, UK. Sunway is NOT Birmingham City University — it is an academic partner college that delivers BCU-validated programs in Nepal.

q: Why should I choose Sunway College?
a: Sunway offers BCU-validated UK degrees delivered in Kathmandu, with 60+ industry partners, an alumni network of 1200+, and dedicated academic advising.

q: Can I visit or tour the campus?
a: Yes. You can take the 360° virtual campus tour online, or visit us in person during office hours.

q: What programs do you offer?
a: Sunway offers BSc (Hons) Computer Science with Artificial Intelligence (4 Years) and BSc (Hons) Business Information Technology (3 Years), both awarded by Birmingham City University, UK.

q: Tell me about the BSc Computer Science with AI program
a: BSc (Hons) Computer Science with Artificial Intelligence is a 4 Years programme worth 480 credits, awarded by Birmingham City University, UK. Programme coordinator: Mr. Rupak Koirala.

q: Tell me about the BIT program
a: BSc (Hons) Business Information Technology is a 3 Years programme awarded by Birmingham City University, UK.

q: How long is the course?
a: CSAI runs for 4 Years and BIT runs for 3 Years.

q: What is the difference between CSAI and BIT?
a: CSAI (4 Years) focuses on computer science and artificial intelligence — best for software, AI, machine learning and data science careers. BIT (3 Years) combines business with technology — best for business analysis, IT consulting and product roles.

q: What is the fee for BIT?

q: Do I have to pay the whole fee at admission?
a: No — not all fees are due at admission. Admission Fee & BCU EPT (if applicable): At time of admission; Security Deposit: At time of admission; University Fee: At time of admission each year; ECA/CCA Fee: Within first week of class start; Semester Fee: Within third week of class start; Annual Fee: Within fifth week of class start.

q: Is there any scholarship available?
a: Sunway offers Merit-Based Scholarship and Sports Scholarship. Scholarship is applicable to the college fee of the first semester. Continuation may occur according to Sunway's scholarship policy. For current scholarship amounts and eligibility, please contact the admissions office — do not rely on third-party or outdated sources.

q: How do I apply for admission?
a: 1. Visit Sunway College or fill the online application form. 2. Submit required documents for verification. 3. Complete fee payment to confirm your admission. 4. Receive admission confirmation and class schedule. You can also apply online at https://sunway.edu.np/apply.

q: What documents are required for admission?
a: You will need: Grade 10 Marksheet, Grade 10 Completion Certificate, Grade 10 Character Certificate, Grade 11 Marksheet, Grade 12 Marksheet, Grade 12 Provisional Certificate, Grade 12 Migration Certificate, Grade 12 Character Certificate, Citizenship Certificate OR Passport, English Proficiency Test Marksheet, Recommendation Letter from previous school, 1 Passport Size Photo.

q: What is the eligibility criteria?
a: For CSAI: NEB Grade 12 or equivalent, with a minimum aggregate CGPA of 2.6. English requirements depend on your Grade 12 English grade — Grade A+ needs no test, Grade B/B+ requires the BCU English Proficiency Test, and below B requires a BCU-recognised proficiency qualification.

q: Do I need IELTS?
a: You do not necessarily need IELTS. If your Grade 12 English grade is A+, no English test is required. For Grade B/B+ you take the BCU English Proficiency Test (approximately NPR 15,000). Below Grade B, a BCU-recognised English proficiency qualification is required.

q: What jobs can I get after this degree?
a: CSAI graduates go into roles such as Software Developer, Software Engineer, Web Developer, Computer Programmer, Java Developer, Python Programmer. BIT graduates go into roles such as Business Analyst, Consultant, IT Product Owner, Solution Developer.

q: Do you help with job placement?
a: Sunway reports a 95% placement rate with 60+ industry partners and an alumni network of 1200+. 95% placement rate and partner statistics are from Sunway's latest prospectus. These represent placement support outcomes and industry connections — they do not constitute a guarantee of individual employment.

q: What is RAIN?
a: Sunway Research and Incubation Center — RAIN is Sunway College's dedicated research and incubation center that helps students and entrepreneurs turn ideas into real businesses through a structured support framework.

q: What facilities does the college have?
a: Sunway Innovation Lab: Sunway's Innovation Lab is a modern facility for hands-on technology exploration and project development. The prospectus showcases practical technology projects developed by students.

q: What clubs and activities are there?
a: Sunway has student clubs including Multimedia Club, Literary Club, Sports Club, Entrepreneurship & AI Club, Creativity Club, Social Club, plus the Sunway Student Representative Council (SSRC).

q: Is there academic support for students?
a: Academic Advisory Unit: Personalized academic support helping students navigate their education, align coursework with career goals and address challenges early. Faculty allocate 2 hours per week for student advising.
